text:
The plan has four paid periods at a total of $40.95 (1199 + 899 + 899 + 1099 cents). Every (episode, follower) pair is watched in time.

**Coverage needs, title by title**

- **Northern Atlas (t2):** This is on Pebble Kids, which is required and auto-renewed, so it is always covered.
- **Glass Kingdom (t4, Northline, Nov 17 – Dec 21):** Northline is already paid through Nov 24, which covers Nov 17–23. No purchase is needed.
- **The Silver Meridian (t3, Northline, released Dec 28):**
  - Eli's window is Dec 28–30 (2 days), the tightest. Ivy's runs to Jan 4 and Tom's to Jan 27.
  - One Northline period starting **Dec 28** covers all three.
- **The Silver Archive (t5, Tidewell, weekly Jan 13 – Mar 17):**
  - Jun and Ivy have 7-day windows, so each episode needs Tidewell access within 7 days of release. Tom's 30-day window is looser.
  - A period starting **Jan 20** gives access Jan 20 – Feb 19. That covers episodes 1–6; episode 1's window ends on Jan 20 and episode 6's window starts on Feb 17.
  - A second period starting **Feb 20** gives access Feb 20 – Mar 19. That covers episodes 7–10; episode 10 is released Mar 17.
  - Two periods are the minimum.
- **The Copper Archive (t1, Orbit, released Feb 8):** Ivy and Jun need access between Feb 8 and Feb 15. One Orbit period starting **Feb 8** covers both.

**Limit of 2 services at once**

- From Nov 1, Tidewell, Northline, Orbit and Kestrel+ all have already-paid access, so nothing new is added during that time.
- Later, at most two non-required services ever overlap:
  - Northline and Tidewell overlap Jan 20–27.
  - Tidewell and Orbit overlap Feb 8 – Mar 7.
- No new period overlaps a service's already-paid access, and Kestrel+ is not needed at all.
